ammonia.reason: Surface lactate assimilation and amino-acid deamination by smear flora raises surface pH to ~6.6 while core stays ~5.7.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from Corynebacterium/Brevibacterium tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism on smear.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides from chymosin alpha-s1 casein cleavage, mostly hydrolyzed by Lactococcus peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no C7-C11 methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone at blue-cheese levels.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine plus fat-mediated dehydration on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis in young washed curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis by starter esterases releasing butanoic/hexanoic acids, medium FFA level vs blue.

creaminess.reason: 28% fat globules lubricate palate and 6-week proteolysis softens paste to creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Washed low-acid curd retains colloidal calcium, cohesive-elastic rather than acid-crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard washed curd at 32% core moisture with calcium-phosphate crosslinked para-casein gives firm-elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism, reported marker of Danbo powder.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate and methyl butanoate from starter esterase esterification of FFA with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no caprine C8-C10 branched acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine Strecker aldehyde 3-methylbutanal and related maltol/pyrazine from light proteolysis and smear.

melt.reason: pH ~5.74 and intact para-casein network allows calcium solubilization and flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from surface Debaryomyces/Brevibacterium lipoxygenase activity on smear.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-fat release on melt from coalesced fat globules in 6-week aged matrix.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic starter plus trace acetic acid; core pH 5.74 gives mild tang.

stretch.reason: No hot-water kneading/acid demineralization, casein does not align into pasta-filata fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism to methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide/trisulfide; light cook limits H2S.

sweet.reason: Residual galactose/glycerol and sweet amino acids proline/alanine after lactose depletion.

umami.reason: Glutamate release by chymosin and Lactococcus peptidases during 6-week proteolysis.
